newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices fall, low overseas buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices fall, low overseas buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Friday fell to 1,186/1,187 rupees per quintal from 1,201/1,202 rupees on fresh speculative selling, dealers said.
"Overseas buying remained at a low ebb while higher new crop arrivals as well as lower domestic demand prompted fresh selling pressure," a dealer said.
Arrivals of castorseed in Gujarat region rose to 35,000 bags (75 kg each) from 30,000 bags on Thursday.
"Export deals for castoroil (ready delivery) were done at 710/720 dollars per tonne last week and thereafter no fresh export demand has been seen," one dealer said.

Groundnut oil remained steady at the improved level of 343/344 rupees per 10 kg on stray seasonal buying while arrivals were also higher at 80/100 tonnes. Imported palm oil remained steady at the reduced level of 277 rupees per 10 kg on fresh physical support. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil remained steady at 519/520 rupees per 15 kg.
